name: Playful
description: Sun-warm peach clay canvas with charcoal ink. Syne display (weight 800, tight negative tracking) + Space Grotesk body. Single-color discipline — no second brand color. Double-stroke offset borders, small rotations, organic blob shapes, SVG doodles. Hand-crafted indie studio warmth.
